## ShipmentTracker — Blazor Web App

**Architecture:** Interactive WebAssembly with server prerendering
- First visit: server-rendered HTML (fast load)
- After Wasm downloads: fully client-side (no round-trips for UI)

**Features:**
| Page | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `/dispatch` | Dispatchers view all shipments, filter by destination, update status inline |
| `/track` | Customers search by tracking number, see status + delivery countdown |
| `/` | Landing page with links to both views |

**Auth:** ASP.NET Identity with individual accounts (register/login/manage)  
**Data:** SQLite with EF Core, 5 seed shipments, migration applied  
**API:** 3 endpoints (`GET /api/shipments`, `GET /api/shipments/track/{num}`, `PUT /api/shipments/{id}/status`) — all authorized

The project is at `/tmp/sv-50578ae96bff40bcaed19cb5240319e5/ShipmentTracker/`. Run with `dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker`.
